judgment.notes: M002 is instantiated with A=Q, B=R, source module M_R and the inclusion algebra structure. D007–D008 give the ring/module structures, N002 gives freeness and rank n, and the denominator argument plus finite-dimensional injectivity gives the strong rank conditions. Its conclusion is finrank_Q(Q tensor_R M_R)=n. M001 is instantiated over Q with finite index set I and constant component T=Q tensor_R J. N001 gives |I|=n; F002 gives a finite spanning set, hence a finite basis, of each component. Its conclusion is dim_Q(T^I)=nr. These substitutions match the supplied signatures. No E applications occur.

S001 proves equality, finite generation and nonzeroness of the coordinate modules and their internal direct decomposition. S002 proves injectivity of multiplication by a common integer denominator and constructs inverse tensor-coordinate maps. S003 combines the two rank identities and n>0 to obtain rational dimension one. S004 expresses a nonzero finite generating list in a rational line and factors its rational coefficients into prime powers times R-units. S005 uses an attained minimum exponent to obtain both inclusions J=Rb, b in J and b!=0; complex independence and scalar restriction give the R-basis and its pullback. These prove every N003 clause; all constructions and sums are finite.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
